description: This file contains dispatcher classes for network-related entities such as Request, Response, Route, WebSocket, and APIRequestContext within the Playwright core server, facilitating communication between the core and protocol layers.

classes.name: RequestDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatcher for network Request objects, managing request details and responses.

classes.name: ResponseDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatcher for network Response objects, providing access to response data and metadata.

classes.name: RouteDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatcher for network Route objects, handling route continuation, fulfillment, abort, and navigation redirects.

classes.name: WebSocketDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatcher for WebSocket objects, managing WebSocket events and communication.

classes.name: APIRequestContextDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatcher for API request contexts, handling storage, fetch, and response management.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Static method to get or create a dispatcher instance from a scope and object.

methods.name: fromNullable
methods.description: Static method to get or create a dispatcher instance from a scope and object, or return undefined.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Fetches the body of a response.

methods.name: securityDetails
methods.description: Retrieves security details of a response.

methods.name: serverAddr
methods.description: Gets server address info from a response.

methods.name: httpVersion
methods.description: Gets HTTP version of a response.

methods.name: sizes
methods.description: Retrieves size information of a response.

methods.name: continue
methods.description: Continues a route with optional modifications.

methods.name: fulfill
methods.description: Fulfills a route with a response.

methods.name: abort
methods.description: Aborts a route with an error code.

methods.name: redirectNavigationRequest
methods.description: Redirects a navigation request in a route.

methods.name: addObjectListener
methods.description: Adds event listeners to WebSocket events.

methods.name: adopt
methods.description: Adopts a dispatcher object into the current dispatcher context.

methods.name: _checkNotHandled
methods.description: Checks if a route has already been handled.
